run_td3_policy_evaluation: run a TD3 policy evaluation on a gym environment with configurable episodes and seed
run_sim2real_test: run the sim2real test script with a loaded TD3 policy on LocoBotEnv-v0
run_real_robot_test: run the TD3 policy test on a real robot with the use_real_robot flag enabled
evaluate_policy_function: evaluate a TD3 policy over multiple episodes and return the average reward
load_and_test_td3_policy: load a trained TD3 policy from file and test it in a gym environment
